thesis: GMAB is a post-spike fade in a risk-off tape. It gapped on unexplained news on Oct 28, has since given back about 10% with lower highs and lower lows, and insiders (CEO, commercial chief, an officer) have been selling into the strength. Valuation is rich (trailing P/E 43.9, forward 32.5) while earnings growth is negative against positive revenue growth, and the SEC series is empty, so growth cannot be verified. The pre-market quote is already above the entry zone, so buying now means chasing, and the stop sits only about 0.8 ATR away, which is easily hit in a VIX-percentile-0.82 market with yields at the 91st percentile. If the unexplained jump was a one-off, the 44.7-45.4 gap is the natural retrace target.
